hypothesis: If repeated failure-stream exposure is displacing the dense expert state coverage needed for action execution, then a matched 20k 6/1/0.5/0.5 sampler will outperform C67's 4/2/1/1 sampler while retaining FACT conditioning.
single_variable: Relative to C67, only the deterministic per-step rank schedule changes from four expert, two success, one observational-failure and one causal-failure samples to six expert, one success and one rank alternating observational/causal failure by absolute-step parity. Model, C58 parent, objective weights, masks, data pools and hashes, seed, optimizer, global batch, schedule, steps and evaluator stay fixed.
parent_baseline: C67 s20000 is the sole matched sampler control; both trajectories initialize from C58B s10000 SHA256 2e6294712f7944037c3982ae7e6b8b87adbdaab190e1972ff4a3d592cc99e541.

references.title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
Bariona/FACT official trainer and episode mixture

architecture.paper: Failure-aware causal training uses one shared causal transformer.

data.paper: Failures supervise consequences without action imitation.
data.upstream_code: FACT sampler separates success and failure episodes and masks failure actions.
data.local: Six expert ranks, one success rank, and rank7 alternating observational/causal failure; all existing pools and masks unchanged.
data.rationale: This is the sole variable and raises dense expert exposure without removing either failure stream.

action.paper: Training and execution action contracts must match.

objective.paper: Failures keep future/value supervision and zero imitation.
objective.local: Unchanged globally_normalize_masked_losses; only the samples contributing to each masked global mean change.
objective.rationale: Loss mathematics and weights remain fixed.

evaluation.local: Every 1k checkpoint uses the frozen balanced80 protocol; only fixed s20 vs C67-s20 may reach fresh paired rollout after offline conditioning gates.

evidence: FACT 618a6c1 and immutable complete source snapshot required.

probe_evidence.failed_attempt_boundary: probe1 used source e6d1009 and failed only because the trainer serialized absent save_checkpoint as the string 'None'; it wrote no checkpoint. Source 45ee644 fixed that reporting defect and probe2 reran the same optimizer step in a fresh output directory.

canary_evidence.claim_boundary: Mechanical ten-step sampler/DDP/checkpoint/strict-restore evidence only; no held-out or rollout effect claim.

effect_preregistration.primary_comparison: C70 sampler s20000 minus C67 sampler s20000
effect_preregistration.offline_gate: Both endpoints strict-restore; C70 must improve normalized and physical means by at least 1%, win at least 55% of samples in both domains, preserve gripper within 0.005 and at least 90% of C67 language/visual response.
effect_preregistration.stop: Any conditioning collapse or failure to improve both action domains keeps C70 out of rollout; no longer budget or checkpoint substitution.
effect_preregistration.interpretation: A pass supports expert state coverage as the sampler bottleneck under the fixed FACT objective; it does not prove FACT auxiliary targets are useful, which remains C69's separate attribution question.

decision.rationale: The non-retained probe and checkpoint-producing ten-step canary passed all finite-loss, all-30-gradient, zero-leak, exact sampler, frozen-H3 and strict-restore gates. This authorizes only the fixed 20k diagnostic trajectory with 1k atomic checkpoints and restores; effectiveness remains NOT_EVIDENCE_READY until the preregistered C70-s20 versus C67-s20 offline gate.
